name: Deck beams, stringers and girders
description: The secondary framing that spans between deck legs and carries deck plate, modules and live load. It is sized by module support points and by blast or accidental load cases as much as by gravity load.

gaps.what: Deck design live load and beam span/depth rules
gaps.why: No page read gives a deck live-load allowance or beam proportioning rule for an offshore deck.
gaps.next_action: Fetch NORSOK C-001 or a design basis and record live load, span/depth and deflection limits

notes: Created 2026-11-27 in the offshore-platform component sweep (item from the platform structure taxonomy). No page read yet for this class, so the gap names the parameter and where to look; Wikipedia is cited only as secondary context.
